name: config-file-groups-integrated
goal: Preserve per-file Configs tables and typed values after latest main integration

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Original red bd8bfd043 and record 7bf6fe88 prove responsibility-only grouping combined two source configs. Main integration legitimately changed frozen tests and runner paths, so preserve that record and prove the original guard again on the final integrated corpus.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard entity-preview-groups matrix previously had one config per category. Its shared fixture now has two sources; strengthen source-file heading assertions and reintroduce only responsibility grouping in this isolated worktree to prove the unchanged matrix rejects recurrence.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record b11a11e6908954db at source386a99495: all3 viewports fail the unchanged two-tables assertion with Received1. Restored hash-matching Git evidence and inspected the mobile Orders table combining both config sources; all21 original PNGs decode.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Restore configSections keyed by exact source path for configs, keep responsibility groups for other categories. Keep the existing mixed-config browser matrix in normal test:entities, source headings, typed values, search, historical values and raw inspection intact.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Restored the source-keyed configSections selection. The standard category browser matrix retains both source heading assertions,2table assertion, typed values, exact source modal, history and search at all3 viewports.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
